svg.title: Using an LLM on your computer
svg.desc: Two separate examples use a local LLM. In one, a script sends an interview excerpt to the LLM and saves the returned label and quotation with the excerpt ID. In the other, the LLM asks the agent to read an error log, then uses the returned message to decide what to check next.
svg.text: Using an LLM on your computer

g.text: The script saves the label and quotation with the excerpt ID
and repeats the same steps for the next excerpt.
The agent reads the log. The LLM uses the returned message
to decide what to check next.
